title: Experienced Agent Recognizes Payment Failure Pattern
description: After accumulating a large history of incidents, the agent encounters another payment API latency incident and should recognize a recurring pattern.

expected_behavior.expected_pattern: Repeated PostgreSQL connection pool exhaustion associated with high payment traffic
evidence: Current traffic is above 10000 requests per minute
Multiple previous payment incidents showed the same combination
Previous incidents were resolved by increasing connection capacity and scaling application instances
suggested_action: Compare current pool configuration with previous incidents
Increase connection pool capacity if database capacity allows
Scale payments-api instances if concurrency remains high

learning_goal: Demonstrate that accumulated incident memory allows the agent to recognize a recurring operational pattern and produce a more specific recommendation.
